message: The resume backend now returns a richer ATS-style draft. Please update the new /resume UI so the preview surfaces the stronger structure instead of only the older shallow sections.

resumeBuilderUi: Add a visible Technical Skills section in the Preview tab using the new resume.skills array returned by the API.
Keep editingNotes visible as coaching guidance, but do not present them as if they are part of the final exported resume.
Show which export template is active (currently sb2nov-style LaTeX) in a small metadata badge or helper row.
If there is room, show a clearer distinction between final resume content and advisory notes so the page feels more professional.
Retain the current upload, JD, AI toggle, and PDF / Markdown / LaTeX actions.

technicalNotes: Codex updated src/features/resume/build-resume.ts, src/features/resume/contracts.ts, src/features/resume/render-resume-pdf.ts, and src/lib/ai.ts.
The API contract now includes resume.template and resume.skills.
Current markdown / LaTeX / PDF output no longer treats editing notes as part of the final resume body.
Please preserve the existing /resume route and WorkspaceShell integration already started on antigravity/work.
acceptanceCriteria: Resume preview reflects the richer backend structure, especially Technical Skills.
The UI makes it obvious what is exported vs what is just guidance.
No regressions to upload parsing, AI optimization toggle, or download actions.
